notes: Major Midnight rework: Freezing stack system replaces Winter's Chill/Icicles. Ray of Frost is now primary DPS cooldown. Frost Splinters are Spellslinger resource.

Frostbolt.description: Primary filler, builds Freezing stacks on target, procs Brain Freeze (~25% chance) and Fingers of Frost (~15%)

Flurry.description: Instant with Brain Freeze proc (+50% dmg). Builds Freezing stacks. Grants Thermal Void buff for Spellslinger.

Ice Lance.description: Shatters 4 Freezing stacks for heavy damage. Use at 6+ stacks (Spellslinger) or with Fingers of Frost. Generates Frost Splinters (Spellslinger: Force of Will).

Glacial Spike.description: High priority on cooldown. No longer requires Icicles in Midnight.

Frozen Orb.description: Press on cooldown always. Triggers Freezing Rain (instant Blizzard). Generates up to 4 Frost Splinters (Splintering Orbs talent). Now tracks moving targets.

Ray of Frost.description: PRIMARY major DPS cooldown in Midnight. Builds Freezing stacks per tick. Has 2 charges with Hand of Frost talent. Glaciate talent reduces CD by 0.1s per Ice Lance shatter.

Icy Veins.description: Secondary cooldown - use on cooldown but no longer primary DPS CD in Midnight.

Blizzard.description: AoE. Highest priority when Freezing Rain proc is active (instant cast). Also use on 7+ enemies even without proc.

Ice Barrier.description: Absorb shield, off-GCD defensive. Apply before pull.

Cone of Frost.description: AoE Freezing stack applicator - key for Mythic+ multi-target chains.

Shimmer.description: Blink without interrupt. Use to dodge mechanics during Ray of Frost channel.

Time Warp.description: Bloodlust equivalent. Use before Ray of Frost or as directed by group.

Summon Water Elemental.description: If talented: Waterbolt +100% damage. With Attuned Familiar talent: 50% chance to conjure Frost Splinters (Spellslinger).

Arcane Intellect.description: Group-wide intellect buff. Apply before combat.

Brain Freeze.description: Makes next Flurry instant and +50% damage. ~25% chance from Frostbolt.
Brain Freeze.expires_action: Cast Flurry immediately (unless Thermal Void is active)

Fingers of Frost.description: Next Ice Lance acts as if target is frozen (ignores Freezing stack threshold). ~15% from Frostbolt, up to 2 charges.
Fingers of Frost.expires_action: Cast Ice Lance (always consume before capping at 2)

Thermal Void.description: Spellslinger: After Brain Freeze Flurry, next Ice Lance shatters 4 additional Freezing stacks. SUPPRESSES Brain Freeze Flurry priority - wait for it to expire.

Freezing Rain.description: Frozen Orb causes Blizzard to be instant cast and deal bonus damage. Top AoE priority when active.

Freezing Winds.description: Spellslinger AoE proc - enables priority Blizzard casting.

Icy Veins.description: Increases haste and spell damage. Use on cooldown (secondary CD in Midnight).

Freezing.description: NEW in Midnight. Stacks up to 20 on target. Applied by Frostbolt and Flurry. Ice Lance shatters 4 stacks per cast. DO NOT let stacks reach 20 (cap = wasted damage).
Freezing.action: Cast Ice Lance at 6+ stacks (Spellslinger) or 10+ stacks (Frostfire)

removed_mechanics.Winters_Chill: REMOVED in Midnight - replaced by Freezing stack system
removed_mechanics.Icicles: REMOVED in Midnight - Glacial Spike no longer requires 5 Icicles
removed_mechanics.Shatter_combo_old: Old Flurry->Ice Lance shatter combo removed. New system: build Freezing stacks, shatter with Ice Lance at threshold

major_cooldowns.name: Ray of Frost
major_cooldowns.use_condition: PRIMARY DPS cooldown. Use after clearing Flurry/Ice Lance priority. Channel fully. Use Shimmer to dodge mechanics mid-channel.

major_cooldowns.name: Frozen Orb
major_cooldowns.use_condition: Always on cooldown. Triggers Freezing Rain for instant Blizzard. Generates Frost Splinters.

major_cooldowns.name: Icy Veins
major_cooldowns.use_condition: Secondary cooldown - use on cooldown. No longer the apex cooldown.

frostfire.name: Frostfire
frostfire.description: Alternative build. Ice Lance threshold: 10+ Freezing stacks (vs 6 for Spellslinger). Currently underperforms Spellslinger in most content.

priority.action: Flurry when Brain Freeze active AND Thermal Void is NOT active
priority.condition: Brain Freeze active AND NOT Thermal Void

priority.action: Ice Lance when Fingers of Frost at 2 stacks (prevent overcap)
Ice Lance with Fingers of Frost (1 charge)
Ray of Frost (Freezing stack builder + major DPS CD)
priority.condition: On cooldown, after clearing Flurry/Ice Lance priority

spellslinger.name: Spellslinger
spellslinger.description: Dominant build for both raid and M+ in Midnight. Generates Frost Splinters via shattering, Frozen Orb, Ray of Frost ticks, Brain Freeze and Water Elemental. Ice Lance threshold: 6+ Freezing stacks.
spellslinger_notes: Only press Ice Lance at 6+ Freezing stacks OR with Fingers of Frost proc
Thermal Void suppresses Brain Freeze Flurry priority - wait for it to expire first
Do NOT let Freezing stacks reach 20 (cap) - wasted damage
Ray of Frost ticks build Freezing stacks AND generate Frost Splinters
Glaciate: each Ice Lance shatter reduces Ray of Frost cooldown by 0.1s
Augury Abounds: chance to burst 8 Frost Splinters when generating one or more

priority_single_target.action: Flurry when Brain Freeze active AND Thermal Void NOT active
priority_single_target.condition: Brain Freeze active AND NOT Thermal Void

priority_single_target.action: Ice Lance when Fingers of Frost at 2 stacks (prevent overcap)
Ice Lance with Fingers of Frost (1 charge)
Ice Lance at 6+ Freezing stacks (Spellslinger threshold)
Ray of Frost - primary DPS cooldown, builds Freezing stacks
priority_single_target.condition: On cooldown, after clearing Flurry/Ice Lance priority

priority_single_target.action: Frostbolt as filler / Freezing stack builder

priority_aoe.action: Blizzard when Freezing Rain proc active (instant cast!)
Flurry when Brain Freeze active AND Thermal Void NOT active
priority_aoe.condition: Brain Freeze active AND NOT Thermal Void

priority_aoe.action: Ice Lance when Fingers of Frost at 2 stacks
Ice Lance with Fingers of Frost (1 charge)
Blizzard on 7+ enemies (even without Freezing Rain)
Ray of Frost (stack builder + DPS CD)

opener.name: Frozen Orb
opener.note: On pull - starts Frost Splinter generation

opener.name: Flurry
opener.note: On Brain Freeze proc (if Thermal Void NOT active)

error_rules.condition: Flurry cast without Brain Freeze active
error_rules.message: Flurry ohne Brain Freeze! Nur mit Brain Freeze Proc casten.
error_rules.explanation: Flurry ohne Brain Freeze ist ein deutlicher DPS-Verlust. Warte immer auf den Brain Freeze Proc.

error_rules.condition: Brain Freeze Flurry cast while Thermal Void is active
error_rules.message: Flurry während Thermal Void! Warte bis Thermal Void abläuft.
error_rules.explanation: Thermal Void supprimiert die Flurry-Priorität. Verbrauche zuerst den Thermal Void Buff mit Ice Lance, dann erst Flurry.

error_rules.condition: Ice Lance cast below 6 Freezing stacks without Fingers of Frost (Spellslinger)
error_rules.message: Ice Lance unter 6 Freezing Stacks ohne FoF! Warte auf 6+ Stacks.
error_rules.explanation: Spellslinger: Ice Lance erst bei 6+ Freezing Stacks oder mit Fingers of Frost Proc. Darunter ist es ein DPS-Verlust.

error_rules.message: Freezing Stacks bei 20 (Cap)! Sofort Ice Lance casten!
error_rules.explanation: Freezing Stacks cappen bei 20. Neue Stacks über dem Cap sind verschwendete Damage. Bei 6+ Stacks (Spellslinger) Ice Lance einsetzen.

error_rules.condition: Brain Freeze overwritten (gained while already active)
error_rules.message: Brain Freeze überschrieben! Sofort Flurry casten wenn Brain Freeze aktiv.
error_rules.explanation: Brain Freeze bei 1 Stack cappen. Überschreiben bedeutet verlorene DPS.

error_rules.condition: Fingers of Frost gained at max 2 stacks
error_rules.message: Fingers of Frost bei 2 Stacks! Ice Lance casten um zu verhindern.
error_rules.explanation: Fingers of Frost cappet bei 2. Neue Procs bei vollem Stack sind verschwendet. Immer bei 2 Stacks Ice Lance casten.

error_rules.condition: Ray of Frost not cast within first 8 seconds of encounter
error_rules.message: Ray of Frost nicht früh eingesetzt! Das ist der primäre DPS-Cooldown in Midnight.
error_rules.explanation: Ray of Frost ist in Midnight der wichtigste DPS-Cooldown (ersetzt Icy Veins). Frühzeitig einsetzen maximiert die Anzahl Nutzungen im Kampf.

error_rules.condition: Frozen Orb not cast within first 5 seconds of encounter
error_rules.message: Frozen Orb am Pull verzögert. Sofort beim Kampfbeginn einsetzen.
error_rules.explanation: Frozen Orb startet Freezing Rain und Frost Splinter-Generierung. Früher Einsatz maximiert Nutzungsanzahl.

error_rules.condition: Ray of Frost channel cancelled before full duration
error_rules.message: Ray of Frost Channel abgebrochen! Nutze Shimmer um Mechaniken zu überstehen.
error_rules.explanation: Ray of Frost muss vollständig gechannelt werden. Shimmer nutzen um Mechaniken zu dodgen ohne den Channel zu unterbrechen.

error_rules.condition: Freezing Rain proc active but Blizzard not cast (AoE situation)
error_rules.message: Freezing Rain aktiv aber kein Blizzard! Sofort Blizzard casten wenn Freezing Rain aktiv.
error_rules.explanation: Freezing Rain macht Blizzard instant und gibt Bonus-Schaden. Das ist die höchste AoE-Priorität für Spellslinger.

error_rules.condition: No spells cast for >2000ms outside expected cast times
error_rules.message: Langer GCD-Gap erkannt! Nutze Instant-Spells bei Bewegung (Ice Lance, Frozen Orb, Flurry).
error_rules.explanation: Immer casten - ein schwächerer Spell ist besser als gar nichts. Bei Bewegung: Ice Lance (FoF), Frozen Orb, Flurry (BF).

gcd.description: GCD-Lücken über dem Schwellwert werden als verschwendete Zeit gewertet
